chat.emptyBody: Be the first to say hello and get the conversation started.

moderation.noToleranceBody: Scams, harassment, and hate speech get you removed with no warning. Be someone people are glad to see in this group.
moderation.reportConfirmBody: It disappears from your chat straight away and the group owner is told. Nobody at Edutu reviews it.
moderation.reportedNotice: You reported this message. It's hidden from you and the group owner has been notified.
moderation.reportGroupConfirmBody: The group owner is told. Nobody at Edutu reviews it, so leave the group too if it isn't for you.
moderation.blockConfirmBody: You stop seeing their messages everywhere in Edutu. You can undo this from Blocked people in the group menu.
moderation.removeConfirmBody: They lose access to this group right away. Their old messages stay, and you can invite them back.
moderation.deleteConfirmBody: The text is gone for everyone, permanently. A note stays in its place so the group knows something was removed.
